# Tales of the Mirror (אגדות המראה)

> Tales of the Mirror — fables about the patterns couples fall into

Seven modern fables about the emotional patterns that wear a relationship down — hypersensitivity, fault-finding, loyalty tests, assuming bad intent, blame, threats of separation and the refusal to forgive — and about recognising your own part and repairing it.

Seven fables, each one about a single pattern that quietly wears a relationship down. They are written to be recognised rather than studied: you read one, you see yourself somewhere in it, and you know what there is to repair.

These are stories, not clinical treatment. They are meant to prompt recognition and a first step, and they do not replace a qualified therapist.

Published in Hebrew, English, Russian, Spanish and Chinese; each
language has its own URL and its own copy of every story.

## Stories (English)

Each fable is about one pattern. The line after the link says which.

### 1. Liryon's Armour of Mirrors

- Pattern: hypersensitivity and feeling persecuted
- Also: hypersensitivity, low self-worth and the sense of being persecuted
- Summary: When you read every kind word as an insult, you end up alone and certain the world turned on you. A fable about hypersensitivity, low self-worth, and the armour that keeps love out.
- Read: https://shayh22.github.io/tells/en/story-1.html
- Other languages: עברית https://shayh22.github.io/tells/story-1.html, Русский https://shayh22.github.io/tells/ru/story-1.html, Español https://shayh22.github.io/tells/es/story-1.html, 中文 https://shayh22.github.io/tells/zh/story-1.html

### 2. Elran's Cloth of Truth

- Pattern: constant fault-finding in a marriage
- Also: a compulsive focus on what is missing and on flaws
- Summary: A thousand golden threads and one faded spot — and the spot is all he sees. A fable about fault-finding, about never noticing what a partner gives, and about the loneliness it earns.
- Read: https://shayh22.github.io/tells/en/story-2.html
- Other languages: עברית https://shayh22.github.io/tells/story-2.html, Русский https://shayh22.github.io/tells/ru/story-2.html, Español https://shayh22.github.io/tells/es/story-2.html, 中文 https://shayh22.github.io/tells/zh/story-2.html

### 3. Arian's Cedar Roots

- Pattern: loyalty tests and cutting off family
- Also: the loyalty test and the demand to tear other bonds apart
- Summary: She asks him to prove his love by cutting off his family. A fable about loyalty tests, about jealousy of a partner's other bonds, and about what is left of a man whose roots are cut.
- Read: https://shayh22.github.io/tells/en/story-3.html
- Other languages: עברית https://shayh22.github.io/tells/story-3.html, Русский https://shayh22.github.io/tells/ru/story-3.html, Español https://shayh22.github.io/tells/es/story-3.html, 中文 https://shayh22.github.io/tells/zh/story-3.html

### 4. Razia's Waters of Revelation

- Pattern: assuming bad intent in a partner
- Also: the illusion of mind-reading, and dressing others in malice
- Summary: She was certain she could read his mind — until his thoughts were shown to her. A fable about mind-reading, suspicion, and years spent fighting a partner who was never the enemy.
- Read: https://shayh22.github.io/tells/en/story-4.html
- Other languages: עברית https://shayh22.github.io/tells/story-4.html, Русский https://shayh22.github.io/tells/ru/story-4.html, Español https://shayh22.github.io/tells/es/story-4.html, 中文 https://shayh22.github.io/tells/zh/story-4.html

### 5. Kai's Burden of Stones

- Pattern: blaming a partner for everything
- Also: the trap of blame, turning a partner into the address for every frustration
- Summary: Every stone in her road became a stone on his back, until his back broke. A fable about blame, about making a partner the address for every frustration, and about what it costs.
- Read: https://shayh22.github.io/tells/en/story-5.html
- Other languages: עברית https://shayh22.github.io/tells/story-5.html, Русский https://shayh22.github.io/tells/ru/story-5.html, Español https://shayh22.github.io/tells/es/story-5.html, 中文 https://shayh22.github.io/tells/zh/story-5.html

### 6. Noit's Cabin Foundations

- Pattern: threatening separation to win an argument
- Also: using separation and the threat of banishment as a weapon for control
- Summary: Every argument ended with "get out" — and every time, another stone left the foundations. A fable about using the threat of separation as a weapon, until the house cannot stand.
- Read: https://shayh22.github.io/tells/en/story-6.html
- Other languages: עברית https://shayh22.github.io/tells/story-6.html, Русский https://shayh22.github.io/tells/ru/story-6.html, Español https://shayh22.github.io/tells/es/story-6.html, 中文 https://shayh22.github.io/tells/zh/story-6.html

### 7. Tamara's Bridges of Ash

- Pattern: refusing to forgive and cutting people off
- Also: demanding perfection, refusing to forgive, and cutting every tie
- Summary: She burned a bridge for every slight, and then the storm came. A fable about demanding perfection from people, about refusing to forgive an ordinary mistake, and about the isolation it builds.
- Read: https://shayh22.github.io/tells/en/story-7.html
- Other languages: עברית https://shayh22.github.io/tells/story-7.html, Русский https://shayh22.github.io/tells/ru/story-7.html, Español https://shayh22.github.io/tells/es/story-7.html, 中文 https://shayh22.github.io/tells/zh/story-7.html
